note: BH-7505: after the hub takes a project's pool tick back from a machine (a stale row, a failed run, or a run that deferred because the machine lacks flyctl, a Fly token, the harness tree or the env bundle), it enqueues no new row for this many seconds and runs the tick itself, so a machine that cannot work does not cost a row per tick. Only with lane_fallback.fly-pool.<project> at hub. 0 enqueues a new row at the next tick. Settings row `lane.fly-pool.pool_fly_takeback_backoff_s`.
